summary: Thích Thiện Châu worked in Buddhist studies. He studied at Paris-Sorbonne University (~1967–1971) and completed a doctoral dissertation at Sorbonne Nouvelle University (~1971–1977).

Tianshu Zhu works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. Educated at Northwest University (MA) and Ohio State University (PhD, 2001–2007) under John C. Huntington, Zhu held posts at Northwest University, Shaanxi History Museum, Korea University, and University of Macau (Associate Professor, 2007).

Tilak Kariyawasam works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He served as head of the Department of Pali and Buddhist Studies at the University of Kelaniya (attested 1993) and Dean of the Graduate School at the International Buddhist College (attested 2014).

Tilmann Vetter was an Indologist and philosopher of Buddhism who studied at the University of Vienna (~1958–1962, PhD) under Erich Frauwallner and Erich Heintel. He succeeded David Seyfort Ruegg and became Professor at Leiden University in 1974.

Timothy Dubber is an Indology and history/archaeology scholar who studied at UNSW Canberra (BA 2009–2011; Master's 2016–2020) and the University of Edinburgh (MSc 2020–2023). He is a PhD candidate at ANU (attested 2025–2026) and Adjunct Fellow at UNSW (2026).

Timothy Hugh Barrett is a scholar of Sinology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. He studied at the University of Cambridge and Yale University, later teaching at Cambridge (attested 1981) before serving as Professor at SOAS University of London from 1986.

Timothy Lenz works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Washington under Richard G. Salomon and Collett Cox (attested 1999), where he also held appointments, serving as professor (attested 2017) and faculty member (attested 2026).

Timothy Lubin is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who earned degrees at Columbia (BA 1982–1986; PhD 1989–1994) and Harvard (MTS 1987–1989). He lectured at Harvard (1994–1996) and Virginia (1996–1997) before becoming Professor at Washington and Lee University in 1997.
Tina Rasmussen works in Buddhist and religious studies. She studied under traditional teacher Pa-Auk Sayadaw and completed an MA supervised by Christian K. Wedemeyer.

Tinatin Aleksandrovna Chavchavadze was a scholar in Iranian and Central Asian studies, Indology, and linguistics. After studying at Tbilisi State University (~1945–1949), she held posts there, at the Institute of Linguistics, and at the Giorgi Tsereteli Institute of Oriental Studies.

Tine Van Overberghe works in Indology and religious studies. She studied at Ghent University (2015–2020) and at the University of Lausanne, where she became an assistante diplômée in 2022 and a PhD student in 2023.

Tine Vekemans is an Indology and religious studies scholar who earned an MA in Oriental Languages and Cultures from Ghent University (2003–2007). She holds the Ācārya Mahāprajña Chair for Jain Studies at Ghent University (attested 2026).

Tirtha Halder works in Indology and philosophy, having studied at the University of Gour Banga, Jadavpur University, Baba Saheb Ambedkar Education University, and Visva-Bharati University. Halder pursues a PhD in Sanskrit at Jawaharlal Nehru University (commenced 2022).

Tirumalai Krishnamacharya was an Indologist and philosopher who studied at Queen's College, Benares, University of Mysore, and under Ramamohana Brahmachari, among others. He taught at Maharaja's Sanskrit College, Mysore (1931) and Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College.

Tissa Rajapatirana was a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies who earned a PhD at the Australian National University (1966–1974) under Jan Willem de Jong. He was later affiliated with ANU's Department of South Asian and Buddhist Studies (attested 1988).

Tista Biswas works in Indology, studying under doctoral supervisor Subuddhi Charan Goswami and serving as Sir William Jones Research Fellow in Sanskritic Studies at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Tiziana Pontillo is an Indologist and linguist who earned a PhD at the University of Milan (1996–2000) and studied at the University of Cagliari (2016). In 2022, she became Full Professor of Sanskrit Language and Literature at the University of Cagliari.
Todar Mall was an Indology scholar who studied under Hermann Jacobi and Arthur Anthony Macdonell.
Todd A. Gibson is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies. He studied at Indiana University Bloomington, earning a PhD attested in 1991, and studied under György Kara.

Todd Thornton Lewis works in religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Columbia University under faculty including Alex Wayman, Margaret Mead, and Ainslie T. Embree, and held a distinguished professorship in world religions at the College of the Holy Cross.
